annotations.text:
Finance lens, Localgov filings.
Layout, hierarchy and density only. Palette and type ramp are the frozen sc-kit, copied byte-identical from the Overview lens, and do not change.
NO FIGURE ON ANY ARTBOARD IS MEASURED. The endpoint has never been called; there is no credential. Every number is fixture, and the FIXTURE badge stays on the page until a real read replaces it.

STRUCTURAL MOVE: the headline is an AGREEMENT, not an amount.
Every finance dashboard opens with a big number. This one opens with whether two independently derived sources agree, and by how much, with both named. The amount is subordinate to its own trustworthiness.
That is the one thing we can build and a spreadsheet cannot: nobody else holds both Localgov and the ledger.

THREE AMOUNTS, NEVER ONE NUMBER.
Filed is what the taxpayer reported owing. Received is what came in, excluding processing fees. Booked is what the ledger recorded. They are three different facts and each names its field and its system underneath.
A single "revenue" tile is exactly how those three silently become one wrong figure.

THE WORKLIST IS WHERE IT EARNS ITS KEEP.
Implied rate is tax due over taxable revenue, compared against the rate in the city ordinance - a SECOND, independently derived source, not another field from the same payload. That is what makes it a real check rather than internal consistency.
Lateness is inferred from an absent timely-filing allowance beside a present penalty. The feed carries no late flag.

THE GAP IS DRAWN, NOT OMITTED.
"Who has not filed" is the most valuable thing a city wants from a tax feed, and this endpoint cannot answer it: every row keys a FILING, none keys a FILER.
It gets a region with a basis line rather than being left off the page, so the gap is countable instead of invisible. One answer from the vendor fills it and nothing else changes.

UNLABELLED IS A REAL STATE, NOT AN ERROR STATE.
The endpoint is called bastrop-filings and returns no tax-type field. Nothing in the vendor spec says hotel occupancy.
So the figures render, the arithmetic checks run, the worklist works - and the page declines to name the tax, and suspends the reconciliation, because matching an unattributed figure to fund 108 would be the assertion rather than the evidence. Degradation declared, not silent.

EMPTY KEEPS EVERY REGION AND ITS BASIS LINE.
The measures stay on the page reading "Not read", never 0, and the empty state says which single grant lights which regions.
Dark here only to show both themes hold; theme is a tweak on every artboard.
